reasonChirho: Ketiv variant readings, hurry/make haste, acquaintance, bereave — very mixed community dominated by textual/scribal notes plus scattered verbs. Communication (text) as primary.
Lamb, lambs, sheep, young male sheep, like a lamb — animals, specifically domestic ovine, with sacrificial overtones.
Prophet (Aramaic) — religious figures who communicate divine messages.
Shut/close physically, shut authoritatively, bar access, stop ears, lock/bolt, close — features of objects (open/shut state) and control.
From where, whence, where, somewhere — spatial position interrogatives and discourse referentials.
Reject, refuse, set aside, nullify, push away, repudiate — holding a view (negatively) and cognitive dismissal.
Yes, thus, so, in this manner, like this — sequential/manner indicators and discourse markers.
Be revealed, come to light, reveal, disclose, manifest, appear, make known — knowledge (making known) and communication.
Announce, declare, report, proclaim, tell news — communication of information.
Recline at table, lie upon, lie down, bedridden, lie placed — stances and physiological states.
Serve, minister to, render service, serve as slave, worship God — helping/caring for and religious activity.
Set apart for divine purpose, separate socially, separate in judgment, exclude, ostracize, divide — dividing and dissociation.
Also, too, both, indeed, surely, how much more/less — emphatic and additive discourse markers.
Vindication, justice, judgment, condemnation, lawsuit, legal case, verdict — courts/legal and punishment.
Mourn, beat the breast, lament, cut branches, grieve — funerals/burial and sorrowful emotions.
Guard, guard post, executioner, bodyguard, guardhouse, watch, assigned duty — military/security personnel and rule.
Be indignant, become angry, enraged, be angry — emotions of anger.
Copulative linking, infinitival to be, participial being, subjunctive may be, existential there is/exists — be/become/exist.
Little, short, brief, few, small in number, barely, diminish — quantity (small) and degree.
Sacrificed to idols, idolater, idol, image, false god — religious activities (idolatrous) and artifacts.
Together, together with, association, company — association and relational joining.
Gentiles, non-Jewish nations, nation, people, ethnic group — groups/classes of persons.
Take away, remove, take up, pick up, gather, lift up, raise, carry, bear — linear movement of lifting/transporting.
Desire, long for, covet, lust after, yearn, wish for, crave — emotions/attitudes of wanting.
Far, from afar, at a distance, distant, onward, further, beyond — spatial positions and dimensions.
Fill, be filled, fill with substance/spirit, fulfill time, band together, stir up strife — quantity (fullness) with some hostile actions mixed in.
Scatter, disperse, squander, waste, spread abroad — linear movement (away from center) and dividing.
Hear, perceive sound, heed, give ear, obey, learn by hearing, be heard, listen, attend — auditory perception and obedience.
You plural, your/yours, 2nd person masculine plural pronoun — discourse referentials for plural addressee.
All, every, the whole, complete, intact, sound, completely, entirely — quantity (universal) and wholeness.
Be silent, keep quiet, keep secret, conceal, put to silence, be destroyed/perish — cessation of communication and destruction.
Show mercy, compassion, be shown mercy, pity, spare, refrain from harming — attitudes/emotions and reconciliation.
Wet, moisten, rain, send rain, precipitation, downpour, rain down judgment — natural substances and physical events.
Reign, rule as king, exercise lordship, have dominion, govern — control/rule and status.
Understand, comprehend, perceive, cause to understand, teach — understanding and learning.
Whoever, whatever, relative pronoun who/which/that, correlative-distributive, indefinite relative — discourse referentials.
Day, daylight, daytime, specific time, lifetime, two days — time units.
Death, put to death active/passive, surely die formula — physiological state of death and killing.
Violent storm, tempest, whirlwind, storm/rage, drive away with tempest — physical weather events.
It is written, Scripture citation, write/compose, recorded text — communication (written) and artifacts.
Hurry, hasten, make speed, press, urge, be hasty — temporal urgency and quick movement.
Righteous, upright, right, just, fair, the Righteous One, declared righteous — moral/ethical quality and legal status.
Bless someone, pronounce blessing, blessed, praise, give thanks to God — communicative acts of blessing and worship.
Meet, encounter, befall, happen to, oppose, confront — movement toward meeting and events that happen.
Haste, quickly, hastily, soon, speed, quickness — time (rapidity) and degree of speed.
Powerless, weak, be weak, lack strength, feeble, thin, gaunt, wasting — inability and physiological decline.
Cast out, expel forcibly, bring forth, produce, send out, dispatch, take out, extract, throw out — movement outward and action.
Run physically, strive in a race, spread rapidly, runner — linear movement (rapid) and contests.
Speak, address, exhort, talk, be spoken, be told, converse, say/tell — verbal communication.
Report, news, message, good news, proclamation, preaching, reward — communication of information.
